Title: My Kingdom for a Horse
Description: The son of a legendary warlord has built a stable in hopes that the return of the Beast Lords will mean he can put his horse training skills to use.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_pointblame" />I knew you had a warrior's heart. Long ago, my brothers stole my inheritance from me.<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> On that day, I swore I would prove the<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" />  blood of my father flowed through my veins by taming the Takhi-- the ancient spirit horses of heaven.
InProgressResponse: Scared? If you’re afraid, don’t go. But if you’re going, don’t be afraid.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_pointblame" />Do you realize what we’ve done, stranger?<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> This changes everything. Look here,<g id="male_gestureup" /> spirits of my ancestors: we have brought the horse to Aeternum!

Title: Hungry as a Horse
Description: Jochi has given you the ingredients to make Basic Mount Vittles. Craft them at any kitchen or campsite.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_think" />In the wild? Yes. But a racing horse is a special breed.<g id="male_agree1" /> With proper care, a good mount will carry you swiftly past the horizon.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_dontknow" />A lazy rider wins few races, my friend.<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" /> See to it that your horse is fed, and then we’ll talk.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_nod2" />Well done! Your horse<g id="male_pointblame" /> looks strong and eager. But a bond<g id="male_agree1" />  is forged through many hours in the saddle.

Title: Hoofing It
Description: Seek out François De La Rama in Weaver's Fen for additional races.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_shrugbrief" />François is a… <g id="male_think" />unique individual, from what I understand.<g id="male_scoldfingerwag" /> But his horsemanship is second to none, and he likes to prove that with difficult races.
InProgressResponse: Keep an eye on François when you find him in Weaver's Fen. He is talented, but he may be a little… hard to trust.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_whatwantfromme" />Well well, what have we here? A dusty rider on a broken mare?<g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" /> Or are you something more? I think<g id="litearmor_think" /> I know who you are. Jochi's new friend, no?

Title: On the Scent
Description: François de La Rama has asked that I seek out a Varangian named Valencia Iznov, saying she might have the secret to riding wolves. I should look for her in Great Cleave and see if I can earn her trust.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />If you'd like to continue your training, that's exactly what you need to do.<g id="litearmor_converseleft" /> I've dealt with this Varangian before -<g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" /> Valencia Iznov is her name.
InProgressResponse: Last time I saw her, Valencia was up in Great Cleave. I can't promise she's still there, but that's your best bet.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_clenchfistsgetpumped" />Stay yourself, stranger!<g id="female_blameshort" /> I have no qualms about sending a<g id="female_impatient" />  wayward traveler back to their spirit shrine the hard way!

Title: A Pack of Knaves
Description: A defector of the Varangian Order seeks aid to free a pack of dire wolves from her former compatriots.
PlayerPrompt: "I wish to bond with a wolf."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />Then you are very naïve or very foolish. The pack is broken,<g id="female_disappointed" /> and the trust of the wolves is lost. No one will be riding them again.
InProgressResponse: You tarry while our wolf-brothers languish in chains? Free the pack first, then we'll talk.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_leftfistthreaten" />You've freed the wolves! The natural order is restored.<g id="female_nodconsider" /> Look for one with a compatible spirit, and<g id="female_leanforwardlisten" /> I will arrange a race to push the limits of your partnership.

Title: Desert Dash
Description: Satiah Rahmotep is collecting a book of records of Aeternum. She has laid out truly challenging courses for those riders who would seek immortal fame.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_applause" />Brimstone. I'll put the spot on your map.<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> I've never run these races myself, but if she is to believed, they are second to none.
InProgressResponse: Look<g id="female_thinking" /> for Satiah out in Brimstone. I'd be more specific, but the desert heat is not for me. Oh, and bring plenty of water for your pack.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardsmall" />Ah, and who is this before me? Not<g id="female_fingerwagno" /> a mirage, I should hope! Whew,<g id="female_waveoffdisdain" /> the heat will get to you quick out here.

Title: A Matter of Pride
Description: Satiah Rahmotep has suggested that I seek out Zinnumun in the Elysian Wilds to further my riding training.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_spreadarms" />It is, and it probably seems like it is hardly the place to compete in races.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> But the creatures that thrive in that environment… I've heard they move like no other.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />I have never been to Elysian Wilds,<g id="female_gestureleftm" /> so I can't tell you what to expect.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What is this before me? A human deep in the territory of the Beast Lords? Perhaps I should…

Title: The Lion's Lament
Description: Zinnumun, matriarch of the Elysian lions, summons Aeternum's greatest hero to liberate her mate Kaluru from the clutches of pretender Lion Lords that seek to end the growing alliance between man and beast.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Their den lies just a short sprint ahead. But be cautious: they are skilled hunters. Free him, and you will have earned my bond as well.
InProgressResponse: You’re back? I don’t see my mate. Perhaps your skills as a hunter are exaggerated.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Because of you, my darling Kaluru runs free. You have proven you have the heart of a lion. Should you require aid, call to me, and I will answer.

Title: Hermit's Rally
Description: Plot a route to the finish line and get there within the time limit.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_gesturedownright" />My people learn to ride at age two,<g id="male_apologizesmall" /> and start racing at age six. I hope<g id="male_dontknow" /> you're at least as skilled as our children. Let's find out.
InProgressResponse: You have already done the impossible, my friend. Do not begin to doubt yourself now. It is no matter if you fall seven times, so long as you have the strength to rise eight.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_pointblame" />I knew you had it in you! Push<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> your limits and your skills will continue to grow.

Title: Warrior's Path Circuit
Description: Jochi Khan has asked me to build a bond between me and my horse by completing the Warrior's Path Circuit.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nod1" />They will. The times<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" /> I've posted are challenging, but pushing youself<g id="male_compliment" /> and your steed to beat them will forge trust between the two of you.<g id="male_nod1" /> Good luck.
InProgressResponse: Don't be intimidated by the tracks. They are meant to be difficult, but that difficulty will make you both stronger. Show me you can do them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_agree1" />You've returned! And I can already see a stronger rider before me.

Title: Smuggler's Ring Circuit
Description: François has posted 5 new races around Weaver's Fen. Complete them to improve your riding skills.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_chuckle" />So I have heard. But Jochi<g id="litearmor_concerns" /> is a romantic in love with the idea of rider and mount as one.
InProgressResponse: You can quit if you would like. These tracks are not for the faint of heart. I suspect you are not the kind to do that, though.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_darnit" />You ride like the wind, stranger.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> I admit, I did not expect to lose. C’est la vie…

Title: White Howl Circuit
Description: In order to better bond with my wolf, I need to run the circuit set up by Valencia Iznov.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />That would certainly work. The pack is swift and strong, and<g id="female_explains" /> showing the wolf that you can guide them would prove you are capable.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_worry" />My races are difficult, but they are meant to be.<g id="female_nodding" /> The wolves need to know your strength.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_salutefistchest" />You and your wolf are now of one spirit.<g id="female_nodding" /> But further challenges will strengthen your bond.<g id="female_leanforwardlisten" /> I have heard of a woman who seeks out the island's greatest champions.<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> Perhaps it is time your legend grows.

Title: Codex Aeternum Circuit
Description: Challenge the race times set by Satiah Rahmotep, and prove you can beat the times set by the ancients.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />I have! And those that lived<g id="female_gesturerightm" /> here before certainly expected much from their competitors.<g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" /> From what I have heard, though, you are not one to be underestimated.
InProgressResponse: I know those times seem difficult, but remember, they were set by those whose legends have lasted for lifetimes. Prove that you deserve to stand among them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />You've come back! And I cannot believe it, you've beaten times that have stood for milennia!

Title: Beast Lord Circuit
Description: Zinnumun has set me to train on the same courses they use to teach their young. I must show I can match or beat the times set by hunting lions.
PlayerPrompt: "I wish to be a peerless rider."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I see… well, as you have proven yourself on many occasions to be a friend of our kind, we will grant you this favor.
InProgressResponse: We expect much from our young. If you are going to stride alongside lions, you must show you can keep up with the pride.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're come back, every bit as capable as a member of our tribe.
